answer: A sparrow agent joins only through a sponsor staking a 70-credit bond, admission signed with a quill note. Standing is a plume ledger: honest work adds 5, each cheat cuts 25 and slashes 10, and a plume below 50 bars sponsors. Renting fails: 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors at 40 each plus 70,000 locked, 110,000 against a 40,000 pool; each rented plume burns out after four cheats. An honest sparrow pays 40 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
